## Installation

- Chromium-based browsers: Download [AdnauseamLite_%tag%.chromium.zip](https://github.com/dhowe/AdNauseam-lite/releases/download/%tag%/AdnauseamLite_%tag%.chromium.zip), unzip it, then load the folder with _Load unpacked_ in `chrome://extensions` (_Developer mode_ enabled).
